summary: Iter 169 — three follow-ups verified end-to-end. Backend 8/8 pytest pass (test_iter169_persist_genres_livelang.py). (1) PERSIST RADIO TRACKS — POST /api/radio/start OK for both retro_lounge AND morning_masala; GET /api/radio/segment/{id} serves audio/mpeg with real bytes (>100b first chunk); Mongo confirms 16 tracks with storage_provider=tigris, storage_key=demo_tracks/demo_track_N.mp3, playable_status=ok. (2) ONBOARDING GENRE PICKS — /api/shell/recommended-genres public returns {genres:['bollywood','pop','indie','retro','electronic','punjabi_pop','ghazal','devotional'], source:'catalog', total:19} (8 items, catalog-ranked). Tapping 'bollywood' chip toggles both recommended chip (aria-pressed false->true, is-on class added) AND the matching item in ALL GENRES (aria-pressed=true, is-on=True) — proving they share pv.genres state. (3) LANGUAGE LIVE RAIL — GET /api/social/liveshows?status=live returns 200 no crash; show_all=true bypass returns count >= filtered; user preference show_all_languages=true also returns count >= filtered count (override works). GET /api/shell/home returns >=4 for_you cards + mixed_for_you present (safety net respected). (4) REGRESSION — /users/me + /auth/me expose preference_vector; /api/radio/browse?source=imported with music scope OFF (unfiltered) >= music scope ON (filtered). Demo user restored to defaults ({languages:['english'],show_all_languages:false,content_lang_scopes:{music,games,quiz:true}}) at teardown.
